npcs.name: Klimmek
npcs.greet: My knees used to climb that mountain. These days they mostly complain about it.

npcs.name: Master Borri
npcs.greet: (Master Borri says nothing. His eyes go to the courtyard gate, and back to you.)

npcs.name: Master Einarth
npcs.greet: (Master Einarth inclines his head, slowly, as if even a nod were a word he must not waste.)

npcs.name: Master Wulfgar
npcs.greet: (Master Wulfgar breathes out through his nose, and the candle beside him gutters.)

relics.name: Klimmek's Bundle
relics.desc: Dried fish, salt, a wheel of hard cheese and a note in careful letters: 'For the Masters, with respect.'

gb_quiet_word: The courtyard is silent but for the wind. Master Einarth sits across from you, eyes closed, and does not move for an hour.
A Word is not a weapon you pick up. It is a truth about the world. FUS is Force, yes. But force is only the shape that patience takes when it runs out.
Jurgen Windcaller learned that at Red Mountain, where his Voice failed him before the Dunmer. He spent the rest of his life listening instead of shouting. So shall we.
gb_master_of_the_voice: The four Masters stand at the corners of the courtyard. They speak your name together, very softly, and the mountain answers. Snow lifts from every roof of High Hrothgar at once.
Many come to us for power. Very few learn that the strongest Voice is the one that chooses silence. You chose it when it was hard.
Go with the Masters' blessing, and walk the Way of the Voice. Whatever the world calls you, here you are called friend, and Master.

quests.title: The Pilgrim's Burden
quests.offer: You look like you're carrying something heavy.
quests.pitch: Supplies for the Greybeards. I've taken them up the Seven Thousand Steps every season since I was a boy, and this season my legs told me no. Would you carry them for me? Mind the frost troll past the fourth shrine. It doesn't respect pilgrims either.
quests.desc: Klimmek of Ivarstead has carried supplies up to the Greybeards every season for most of his life. His legs have failed him, and he asked me to take this season's bundle to High Hrothgar.

objectives.text: Begin the climb of the Seven Thousand Steps
Kill the frost troll on the pilgrims' road
objectives.journal: The troll had been sleeping in the lee of one of the old pilgrim tablets. It woke angry. The tablet, when I could read it, spoke of patience.

objectives.topic: Klimmek sends these, with his apologies that he couldn't bring them himself.
objectives.reply: Tell him his offering was received, and that the mountain remembers every step he has taken on it. So do we. You might remember them too, next time you climb.

quests.outro: I carried Klimmek's offering up the Seven Thousand Steps to High Hrothgar, as he has done every season since he was a boy.

quests.title: The Breath Between Words
quests.desc: Arngeir says that to learn the Voice I must learn to be silent. I am to sit with the Word FUS in the courtyard of High Hrothgar without speaking it.

objectives.topic: You said there was more to learn.
objectives.reply: There is always more. You have learned to shout FUS and push the world aside. Now sit with the Word without speaking it. Learn what it is, before you learn again what it does. Master Einarth will sit with you.

objectives.text: Meditate on the Word FUS in the courtyard
objectives.journal: For a long time the Word sat in my chest like a stone. Then, near dusk, it was only a word, and the stone was me.

objectives.text: Tell Arngeir what the Word taught you

choices.label: That force is only a door. What matters is where it opens.
choices.reply: Well said. Many push without asking what is on the other side. Remember that you asked.

choices.label: That every push is also a refusal.
choices.reply: Yes. To use force is to say no to every other way. Sometimes that is right. Less often than people think.

choices.label: That I'm stronger than I knew.
choices.reply: Strength is the first thing the Voice reveals, and the least important. Sit with it again someday. It will tell you more.

quests.outro: I meditated on the Word FUS with Master Einarth in the courtyard of High Hrothgar. Arngeir says the Voice is learned in the silence between Words as much as in the Words themselves.

quests.title: The Wind Runs Ahead
quests.desc: Master Borri has a Word of Whirlwind Sprint to give me. Arngeir says that to understand it I must run ahead of the wind, in the courtyard and on the mountain.

objectives.topic: Master Borri. Arngeir says you have a Word for me.
objectives.reply: (Borri lets out one breath of a Word, so quietly it barely stirs the snow. NAH: Fury. It settles into you like a second heartbeat.)

objectives.text: Run the courtyard of High Hrothgar on the wind
Go down to the broken stretch of the Seven Thousand Steps
Cross the broken steps with Whirlwind Sprint
objectives.journal: The gap in the old stairway was too wide to jump. With the Words in my throat, it was not a gap at all.

objectives.reply: Master Borri felt it from here. He says you are too eager, and that you will learn. From Borri, that is high praise.

quests.outro: Master Borri gave me the second Word of Whirlwind Sprint, and I crossed the broken stretch of the Seven Thousand Steps on the wind.

quests.title: Words on Stone
quests.desc: Arngeir sent me to Rannveig's Fast, west of Whiterun, where the dragons once carved a Word of Kyne's Peace into a wall. A Word learned from the stone, he says, teaches what no Master can.

objectives.reply: Something we cannot give you. The dragons carved their Words into walls across Skyrim, and some of them still sing to those who can hear. At Rannveig's Fast there is a Word of Kyne's Peace: the Voice that calms instead of breaks. Go and listen to it.

objectives.text: Fight through the dead of Rannveig's Fast
Learn the Word on the wall
objectives.journal: The wall spoke a Word in a voice like a herd of deer moving through snow. KAAN: Kyne. I understood it the way you understand warmth.

objectives.topic: I learned the Word of Kyne's Peace.
objectives.reply: Then you have learned that the Voice can quiet a beast as easily as it can kill one. Most never wonder about that. Let me help you understand it fully.

choices.label: Why did the dragons teach a Word of peace at all?
choices.reply: Perhaps not all of them loved war. Perhaps one did, once, and then grew tired. Paarthurnax could tell you more than I can.

choices.label: I'd rather have learned something stronger.
choices.reply: Stronger. You will see, one day, that you did.

quests.outro: I learned a Word of Kyne's Peace from the dragon wall at Rannveig's Fast. Arngeir helped me to understand it, and to see that the Voice can calm as well as break.

quests.title: Master of the Voice
quests.desc: A Nord sellsword named Hrolfgar Thunder-Throat has learned a Word of Power from some ruined wall and is using it to raid the farms along the White River. Arngeir has asked me to stop him without becoming what he is.

objectives.reply: A man called Hrolfgar has found a Word and uses it to knock farmers down and take their grain. He camps at Valtheim Towers and boasts that he will come here next, to make us teach him the rest. The Voice is not for war. Stop him. But remember what you are, while you do.

objectives.text: Bring Hrolfgar Thunder-Throat to his knees
objectives.journal: Hrolfgar shouted until he was hoarse and swung until his arms shook. When he finally went down, he begged me to teach him the next Word.

objectives.reply: And? What did you do with a beaten man who begged you for power?

choices.label: I told him the Word he wanted was silence, and sent him home.
choices.reply: Then you have understood the Way of the Voice better than he ever will. Come into the courtyard. The Masters are waiting.

choices.label: I made sure he'll never raid again.
choices.reply: Perhaps that was needed. I will not judge you for it. But think on it, in the quiet. Come; the Masters are waiting anyway.

quests.outro: I stopped Hrolfgar Thunder-Throat from turning his stolen Word on the farms of Whiterun and on High Hrothgar. The Greybeards spoke my name together and called me a Master of the Voice.
